steps.text: Passo 1 — Cadastre e escolha o tipo

steps.js: (() => { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLSelectElement.prototype, 'value').set; const m = document.querySelector('#new-session-modality'); setter.call(m, 'mod_mentoria'); m.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); const s = document.querySelector('#new-session-template'); if (s.options.length > 1) { s.selectedIndex = 1; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); } return m.value + '/' + s.selectedIndex; })()
